paragraphs: I'm applying for the Associate, Strategic Finance role at Uber in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested in Uber because strategic finance there sits close to big operating decisions across a lot of businesses, and that's the kind of finance work I want to do.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked as a consultant on marketing-channel budget allocation, built models to evaluate $10M in spend, and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership.

That maps to building the forecast, pressure testing plans with business partners, and helping decide where money should go. I'm comfortable turning a messy question into a clear model and a short recommendation. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
